style.pixel: crisp pixel art with clean dark outline, HD-2D JRPG style (like Octopath Traveler and classic 16-bit handheld JRPGs)
style.keyBg: Solid flat pure magenta #FF00FF background filling everything around the subject; the subject itself must not use any magenta or hot-pink #FF00FF color
style.noText: no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature, no UI, no frame, no border
style.original: original character design, no logos or symbols from existing franchises
style.kawaii: Cuteness rules (they override any age, build or mood wording in the description, while the hair, colours, outfit and signature item stay recognisable; older characters keep their grey or white hair, beard or glasses but stay soft, round and never wrinkled or grim): moe gacha-game anime look, a soft rounded face with chubby cheeks and a small chin, huge sparkly anime eyes with two or three white highlights each, light rosy blush on the cheeks, a gentle smile or playful happy expression, soft fluffy hair with glossy highlights, a modest outfit, nothing scary, grim, edgy or sexualised
style.cutePixel: crisp pixel art with a clean dark outline, cute 16-bit JRPG style with soft pastel-leaning shading

character.prompt: Super cute kawaii pixel art character walking sprite sheet for a top-down 2D RPG overworld (classic 16-bit handheld JRPG sprites with a moe chibi look): {desc}. Character note: {detail}. {style.kawaii}. Sprite proportions: super-deformed chibi about 2 heads tall, an oversized round head about as big as the rest of the body, big shiny eyes that stay readable at a small size, a small soft rounded body with short stubby limbs and tiny feet, a cheerful bouncy walk with a little arm swing. Exactly 4 rows x 4 columns grid of equally sized cells. Row 1: walking facing down toward the viewer (4 frames). Row 2: walking facing left, side view, nose pointing to the left edge (4 frames). Row 3: walking facing right, side view, nose pointing to the right edge (4 frames). Row 4: walking facing up/away, back view (4 frames). Same character, same size, consistent proportions in every cell, full body from head to feet inside every cell with clear empty space between figures, {style.original}, {style.cutePixel}. {style.keyBg}. No ground shadow, no grid lines, no text.

On the left ledge stand five girls as a happy group: DeepSeek girl in front as the protagonist (slightly larger, pointing toward the horizon), with GPT girl and her floating cloud buddy, Gemini girl, Claude girl hugging her book and MiniMax girl holding her conch. On the right ledge stand four girls: Kimi girl raising her prism with a little rainbow beam, Qwen girl with her open fan, GLM girl with a fang grin and Grok girl holding her X halberd. All nine are about the same chibi size (about 28% of the image height), complete and unobstructed, looking toward the viewer and the vista. The valley between them: a sweeping fantasy-tech vista: on the far left horizon a futuristic city of slender glowing data towers with holographic rings and small airships, in the centre the low setting sun over a lake town with warm lit windows, a stone arch bridge and a river reflecting the sky, on the far right snowy mountains with waterfalls and a radiant AGI temple castle with a halo of light on the highest peak. Every girl is a super cute chibi anime girl about 2.5 heads tall exactly like the identity sheet: big round head, huge sparkly eyes with white highlights, rosy blush, happy smile, small rounded hands and feet, modest complete outfits; faces clearly readable and facing the viewer (three-quarter view at most), drawn with the same pixel-art technique and lighting as the scenery so they belong in the world; each girl has exactly two arms and two legs and only her own ears, tail, wings or horns. Identities to keep: GPT girl: very long fluffy silver-white hair, lavender eyes, curved white dragon horns, pointed elf ears, small white dragon wings and a white scaly dragon tail, a flowing white Chinese-style dress with white knot ornaments, and a tiny round smiling blue-white cloud buddy floating near her hand; Gemini girl: long wavy hair fading from blue to violet-pink, blue cat ears and a fluffy purple cat tail, heterochromatic pink and golden eyes, a rainbow four-pointed-star hairpin, a navy-violet starry dress with white frills and wide sleeves, and tiny rainbow four-pointed star sparkles floating beside her; Claude girl: very long copper-orange hair, warm amber eyes, an orange sunburst flower and a black ribbon in her hair, a cream-white long dress with black and orange layered panels and small gold details, hugging a brown hardcover book; MiniMax girl: fluffy shoulder-length coral-orange hair, warm red eyes, a white beret with a pink bow, a white jacket with pink lining, a beige plaid skirt, white-and-pink sneakers, a small cream shoulder bag with a tiny clapperboard, holding a little orange conch shell; DeepSeek girl (the protagonist): long wavy hair fading from deep navy blue to light sky blue with a big curled ahoge, round bright blue eyes, a white frilly maid headband with small blue bows, dark navy whale-fin ears, a navy maid dress with puffed sleeves, a white frilled apron with a tiny whale emblem, white tights, navy shoes and a big curved navy whale tail; Kimi girl: very long wavy silver-white hair with a pale blue tint, lavender eyes, a white lace maid headdress with a navy bow and a crescent-moon hairpin, a navy-and-white music-themed frilled dress with a piano-key hem, holding up a small glass prism that casts a short rainbow beam; Qwen girl: long periwinkle blue-violet hair with one long side braid, violet eyes, a small navy beret-like hat with a blue flower emblem, a white-and-blue Chinese hanfu-style dress with a wide dark-navy overcoat and gold trim, holding an open blue folding fan; GLM girl: long black hair with deep purple highlights and an ahoge, violet eyes, a playful grin with one tiny fang, a square black-gold hairclip with a Z mark and a black ribbon, a black-and-gold gothic lolita dress with purple frills, black tights and black shoes; Grok girl: long blonde twin-tails, bright blue eyes and a tiny fang smile, a small black-gold crown, little black bat wings, pointed ears, a black and crimson gothic ball-gown dress with gold ring ornaments, holding a toy-like black-gold X-shaped double-bladed halberd taller than herself. Title-screen layout (strict): the game logo will cover the top centre and a menu box the bottom centre. Keep the area from 25% to 75% of the width, from the top down to 48% of the height, free of characters and tall foreground objects (only sky, clouds and distant scenery there). Keep the bottom centre (35% to 65% of the width, 55% to 85% of the height) calm and low-detail: soft meadow, path or water, no characters. All characters stand in the left third or the right third of the frame, never closer than 9% to the left or right edge, with every head, hair tip, ear, wing and prop below 20% of the image height and every foot above 80% of the image height. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no signature, no UI, no frame, no border (the tiny Z hairclip mark is the only letter shape allowed).

walkVideo.prompt:
How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the {endSec}-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated pixel art, a static shot frames the same small chibi pixel-art character shown in Picture 1, {facing}, standing in the centre of a solid flat magenta background with no floor, shadow or scenery. The background stays the same pure flat magenta in every frame: it never changes colour or brightness and no circles, glows, gradients or shapes appear behind the character, and no sparkles, particles or light effects appear anywhere. The camera holds a perfectly static shot. The character walks in place on the spot without moving across the frame: one leg steps forward while the other pushes back, the feet pass under the body, then the other leg steps forward, repeating a steady looping walk cycle with clearly alternating legs, a small bounce of the head and body and a light arm swing. The character keeps the same size, position, facing, outline, colours and crisp pixel style throughout, and at the end settles back into the exact standing pose, position and composition established by Picture 2.

overall_soundscape: Soft light footsteps tap in a steady even rhythm on a quiet background.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
walkVideo.promptFirstFrame:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] HD-2D game pixel animation, a full-body orthographic view of the small chibi character in Picture 1: {appearance}. The character stays {facing} throughout the shot. Keep the exact reference hair, outfit, accessories, head-to-body proportions, palette and clean dark pixel outline. The camera is completely static: no pan, zoom, rotation, cut or perspective change. The character stays centered at the same size on a completely uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background with no floor, shadow, scenery, text or added effects. Starting from the reference pose, the character performs three relaxed walking cycles on the spot, each cycle approximately one second long. One foot reaches forward while the opposite foot pushes back; the swing foot passes low under the hips; the opposite foot then reaches forward and the first foot passes beneath the hips. The knees bend slightly with a low foot lift and at least one supporting sole planted at every moment. This is everyday walking, not running, kicking, marching or hopping. Free arms swing gently from their shoulders opposite their corresponding legs, with slight elbow bends. Every small hand stays continuously attached to its wrist and forearm or sleeve; hands carrying an existing item keep their grip and move naturally with that arm. Both shoulders, torso, hips, elbows, wrists, knees, two hands and two feet stay complete and move as one anatomically coherent body. Existing carried items, hair and backpack follow with tiny secondary sway, never separating from their attachment points. The head keeps the same facing with only a tiny natural vertical bob. Preserve chunky square pixel clusters without a smooth painted or realistic makeover. No disappearing hands, floating body parts, new props or new accessories. The character continues walking evenly through the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape: Quiet even footsteps and faint clothing movement. No dialogue or vocalizations.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
